description: The multifurcation system prompt MUST anchor 'one story' on the 3-6 acceptance-scenario floor and require an Actor+Verb+Object no-conjunctions title check before proposing any sub-issue. Without this anchor (α.44/α.45) the prompt over-split bounded inputs into per-field/per-axis sub-tasks. The prompt also MUST handle recursion: when the input body has a `Split from #N (slowcook multifurcation)` footer the model should lean toward 'one' unless the body still has 2+ distinct user outcomes meeting the floor.

captured_from.context: Dogfooded against delgoosh#640 → 7 sub-issues filed → 6 of 7 got re-multifurcated. PM-led review (docs/dogfood/2026-05-24-multifurcation-recursion.md) showed the depth-2 splits were correct given the epic-scale parent — but the prompt had no defined granularity floor, so a depth-3 attempt on a story-sized input like 'Patient can edit their name' would have continued to invent sub-tasks. α.46 codifies the floor + recursion-aware calibration.

expected_prompt_includes: fold it back into its sibling
When the input was itself a multifurcation output
expected_prompt_excludes: If you have fewer than 3, this is probably ONE story
